title: Simply Fast Mods
description: This mod pack contains a few mods that are more than enough to play without any performance errors and losing the vanilla experience. This is certainly the Vulcan version.
body: There are a few changes in this pack that are more than sufficient to play without experiencing any performance issues or losing the original experience. This is undoubtedly the Vulcan version. Although this still functions on some older systems, I'll release the Optine version for older computers as well.
